verifyProof(bytes,uint256[1]).notice: Verify a Groth16+BSB22 proof. `proof` byte layout (all coordinates big-endian, all G2 components in EIP-197 order — produced by `provekit-cli export-evm-proof`):   bytes   0 ..  64 : Ar           (G1: X, Y)   bytes  64 .. 192 : Bs           (G2: X.c1, X.c0, Y.c1, Y.c0)   bytes 192 .. 256 : Krs          (G1: X, Y)   bytes 256 .. 256 + 64·N_COMMIT       : Commitments (G1 each)   bytes 256 + 64·N_COMMIT ..  +64      : CommitmentPok (G1) Total length: 256 + 64·(N_COMMIT + 1). `input` carries only the EXPLICIT public inputs (N_PUB of them); the BSB22 challenge wires are derived on chain in `_deriveCommitmentChallenges`.
